sections.heading: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
content: As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare Local Coverage Determinations (LCD's) as outlined below. In addition to this policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

subsections.heading: Babesiosis
content: 1. To detect Babesia microti , Nucleic Acid Amplification Tests ( NAAT) testing, including Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) testing, (CPT code 87469) IS REIMBURSABLE for individuals with one of the following symptoms: • Body aches • Chills • Fatigue • Fever • Hemolytic anemia • Hepatomegaly • Insect bite • Jaundice • Splenomegaly • Weakness

2. For individuals with a diagnosis of Babesiosis, the use of either an Immunoglobulin G (IgG) or Immunoglobulin M (IgM) indirect immunofluorescence antibody (IFA) assay (CPT code 86753) for Babesia IS NOT REIMBURSABLE .

subsections.heading: Borrelia
content: 1. To detect Borrelia spp., NAAT testing, including PCR testing, (CPT code 87478), an IFA assay for Immunoglobulin G (IgG) antibodies (CPT code 86619) or detection by immunoblot of Immunoglobulin G (IgG) or Immunoglobulin M (IgM) antibody (CPT code 0043U, CPT code 0044U) IS REIMBURSABLE for individuals with one of the following symptoms: • Arthralgia • Chills • Headache • Insect bite • Myalgia • Nausea • Vomiting

subsections.heading: Dengue Virus
content: 1. For individuals with a diagnosis of classical or hemorrhagic dengue fever, the hemagglutination inhibition test (CPT code 86280) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

subsections.heading: Ehrlichiosis and Anaplasmosis
content: 1. To detect Anaplamsa phagocytophilum or Ehrlichia chaffeensis, NAAT testing, including PCR testing, of whole blood (CPT code 87468, CPT code 87484) or an IFA assay for Immunoglobulin G (IgG) antibodies (CPT code 86666) IS REIMBURSABLE for individuals with one of the following symptoms: • Fever • Gastrointestinal issues, including nausea, vomiting and diarrhea • Headache • Insect bite • Malaise • Myalgia • Shaking chills

subsections.heading: Plasmodium (Malaria)
content: 1. The use of an IFA assay for Plasmodium antibodies (CPT code 86750) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

subsections.heading: Rickettsiosis
content: 1. The use of an IFA assay for Immunoglobulin G (IgG) antibodies to Rickettsia (CPT code 86757) IS REIMBURSABLE twice when at least two weeks has passed between tests and IS ONLY REIMBURSABLE for individuals with any of the following symptoms: • Abdominal pain • Anorexia • Chills • Fever • Headache • Insect bite • Malaise • Myalgia • Nausea • Photophobia • Skin rash • Ulcerative lesion with regional lymphadenopathy for Rickettsia species 364D rickettsiosis • Vomiting
2. For individuals with a diagnosis of typhus fever or Rickettsiosis, blood culture testing (CPT code 87040) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

subsections.heading: West Nile Virus
content: 1. The use of an IFA assay for Immunoglobulin M (IgM) antibodies specific to West Nile virus (CPT code 86788, CPT code 86789) IS REIMBURSABLE for individuals with any of the following symptoms: • Abdominal pain • Altered level of consciousness • Arthralgia • Fatigue • Fever • Headache • Insect bite • Maculopapular rash • Myalgia • Nausea • Neck stiffness • Vision loss • Vomiting • Weakness
2. For individuals with a diagnosis of West Nile virus infection, the use of an IFA assay for Immunoglobulin G (IgG) antibodies specific to West Nile virus (CPT code 86789) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

subsections.heading: Zika Virus
content: 1. NAAT testing including, PCR testing, (CPT code 87662*) or Immunoglobulin M (IgM) testing (CPT code 86794*) for Zika virus IS REIMBURSABLE for individuals with any of the following symptoms: • Abnormal brain development • Conjunctivitis • Decreased joint movement • Feeding problems • Fever • Headache • Hearing loss • Joint pain • Microcephaly • Muscle pain or stiffness • Rash • Seizures • Suspected exposure to Zika virus • Ultrasound findings consistent with congenital Zika virus • Vision problems

subsections.heading: General
content: 1. For asymptomatic individuals, testing for Babesiosis, Borrelia, Dengue virus, Ehrlichiosis and Anaplasmosis, Plasmodium, Rickettsiosis, West Nile virus or Zika virus with the tests discussed above IS NOT REIMBURSABLE. Applicable procedures for Medicare Advantage plans *The payment criterion for CPT code 86794, CPT code 87662 apply to all Medicare jurisdictions, except those states awarded to Noridian Healthcare Solutions, LLC.
